ts.2: Best profit from day i on, given whether we hold a share.
ts.3: No days left: nothing more to earn.
ts.4: Option: do nothing today and keep the same state.
ts.5: Holding: either wait, or sell today and skip tomorrow, the rest day.
ts.6: Not holding: either wait, or buy today and pay the price.
ts.8: Start on day 0 with no share.

py.3: Best profit from day i on, given whether we hold a share.
py.6: Option: do nothing today and keep the same state.
py.8: Either wait, or sell today and skip tomorrow, the rest day.
py.9: Not holding: either wait, or buy today and pay the price.
py.11: Start on day 0 with no share.

ts.3: Three end-of-day states: holding a share, just sold today, free with no share.
ts.4: dp[i][s] is the best profit at the end of day i in state s.
ts.5: Day 0: holding means we bought it; selling is impossible; resting earns nothing.
ts.6: Fill each later day from the day before.
ts.8: Hold: kept from yesterday, or bought today after a free day, never right after a sale.
ts.9: Sold today: we must have held yesterday, and gain today's price.
ts.10: Free: rested yesterday too, or sold yesterday so today is the forced rest.
ts.12: End without a share: the better of just sold and free.

py.5: dp[i] is the best profit at the end of day i for hold, sold, rest.
py.6: Day 0: holding means we bought it; selling is impossible; resting earns nothing.
py.7: Fill each later day from the day before.
py.8: Yesterday's best profit in each of the three states.
py.10: Hold: kept or bought after a free day; sold: sell what we held; rest: stay free or cool down.
py.11: End without a share: the better of just sold and free.

ts.2: Day 0: holding means we bought; nothing sold yet; resting earns nothing.
ts.3: Each later day updates the three states from yesterday's.
ts.5: Update all three at once from yesterday's values; buying only from a free day, never after a sale.
ts.7: End without a share: the better of just sold and free.

py.3: Day 0: holding means we bought; nothing sold yet; resting earns nothing.
py.5: Update all three at once from yesterday's values; buying only from a free day, never after a sale.
py.6: End without a share: the better of just sold and free.
